reviews.comment: She would talk about things in the PowerPoints that were completely unrelated to the homework, making you essentially teach yourself the subjects. She also doesn't really accept any feedback on her teaching. Her class wasn't that hard but I did not enjoy her as a professor. This is also her first year at A&M and she came from Tulane.

This was her first semester teaching so she could have learned some things for next year, but overall she was not great. She was not very good at explaining concepts, and she had us memorize a ton of things for the exams including six 30 page case studies. She had to apply major curves so that people would pass her class. Do Not Take!
